theorems.name: CFDLean.squareSum_mul
theorems.summary: Scaling a vector by a multiplies its sum of squares by a².
theorems.source: references/M1.md map row 'Finite sum scaling identities'; accepted list: Integrity.lean

theorems.name: CFDLean.squareSum_div
theorems.summary: Dividing a vector by a divides its sum of squares by a².
theorems.source: references/M1.md map row 'Finite sum scaling identities'; accepted list: Integrity.lean

theorems.name: CFDLean.pressure_toConservative
theorems.summary: For γ ≠ 1 and ρ ≠ 0 the pressure of a converted primitive state is its prescribed pressure.

theorems.name: CFDLean.primitive_roundTrip
theorems.summary: For γ ≠ 1 and ρ ≠ 0 converting a primitive state to conservative and back returns it.

theorems.name: CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip
theorems.summary: For γ ≠ 1 and ρ ≠ 0 converting a conservative state to primitive and back returns it.

theorems.name: CFDLean.primitive_admissible_toConservative
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 an admissible primitive state converts to an admissible conservative state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimitive
theorems.summary: An admissible conservative state converts to an admissible primitive state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_pos
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 a conservative state is admissible iff ρ > 0 and its energy exceeds the kinetic energy Q(m)/(2ρ).

theorems.name: CFDLean.admissible_exists
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 the admissible conservative domain is nonempty in every dimension.

theorems.name: CFDLean.dot_add
theorems.summary: The dot product is additive in its second argument.

theorems.name: CFDLean.dot_mul
theorems.summary: The dot product is homogeneous in its second argument.

theorems.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_add
theorems.summary: The physical Euler flux is additive in the oriented area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul
theorems.summary: The physical Euler flux scales linearly with the oriented area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the oriented area vector negates the physical Euler flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.physicalFlux_zero
theorems.summary: The physical Euler flux through a zero area vector is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.decode_encode
theorems.summary: Decoding the five-coordinate encoding of a 3D conservative state returns the state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.encode_decode
theorems.summary: Encoding a decoded five-coordinate vector returns the vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_coordinateFlux
theorems.summary: For nonzero density the explicit physical Jacobian is the Fréchet derivative of the fixed-normal Euler flux in state coordinates.

theorems.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.isOpen_admissible
theorems.summary: The admissible set is open in state coordinates.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal_dot_self
theorems.summary: The unit normal of a nonzero area vector has unit length.

theorems.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_integratedFlux
theorems.summary: For nonzero density and area the derivative of the area-integrated flux is the area times the Jacobian at the unit normal.

theorems.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.jacobian_action
theorems.summary: The physical Jacobian applied to a perturbation is given by the explicit formula in velocity, normal speed, pressure perturbation and total enthalpy.

theorems.name: CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.hasFDerivAt_zeroArea
theorems.summary: The flux through a zero area vector has zero derivative at every state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.root_pos
theorems.summary: The square-root density used by the Roe average is positive for positive density.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.root_sum_pos
theorems.summary: The sum of the two square-root densities is positive for positive densities.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.weight_pos
theorems.summary: Each Roe averaging weight is positive for positive densities.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.weight_lt_one
theorems.summary: Each Roe averaging weight is smaller than one for positive densities.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.weight_sum
theorems.summary: The two Roe averaging weights sum to one.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap
theorems.summary: The Roe-averaged velocity, enthalpy and sound-speed square are symmetric in the two states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity
theorems.summary: The averaged sound-speed square is the weighted mean of the endpoint sound-speed squares plus a velocity-jump variance term.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare_pos
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 and admissible states the averaged sound-speed square is positive.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_pos
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 and admissible states the averaged sound speed is positive.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed_sq
theorems.summary: For γ > 1 and admissible states the averaged sound speed squares to the averaged sound-speed square.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_state
theorems.summary: The state recovered from Roe's parameter vector is the original state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.parameter_flux
theorems.summary: The flux recovered from Roe's parameter vector is the physical coordinate flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterState
theorems.summary: B is the Fréchet derivative of the parameter-to-state map.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterFlux
theorems.summary: C is the Fréchet derivative of the parameter-to-flux map.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.state_midpoint_jump
theorems.summary: The state jump is B at the parameter midpoint applied to the parameter jump.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump
theorems.summary: The flux jump is C at the parameter midpoint applied to the parameter jump.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.midpoint_pos
theorems.summary: The parameter midpoint of two positive-density states has positive first component.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_bijective
theorems.summary: B is bijective for γ ≠ 0 and nonzero first parameter component.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.inverseB_B
theorems.summary: The explicit inverse of B is a left inverse.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.B_inverseB
theorems.summary: The explicit inverse of B is a right inverse.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.operator_B
theorems.summary: The Roe operator at the parameter velocity and enthalpy composed with B equals C.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B
theorems.summary: The Roe matrix composed with B at the parameter midpoint equals C at the midpoint.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_CB_inverse
theorems.summary: For admissible states the Roe matrix is C composed with the inverse of B at the parameter midpoint.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.secant_identity
theorems.summary: For admissible states the Roe matrix maps the state jump to the flux jump (Roe property U).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant
theorems.summary: For admissible states and nonzero area the area-scaled Roe matrix at the unit normal maps the state jump to the integrated flux jump.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_continuousOn
theorems.summary: The Roe matrix is jointly continuous on pairs of admissible states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_diagonal
theorems.summary: At two equal positive-density states the Roe matrix is the physical Jacobian.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_diagonal
theorems.summary: At an admissible state the equal-state Roe matrix is the derivative of the physical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_equal_state_limit
theorems.summary: The Roe matrix tends to the physical Jacobian as both states tend to the same admissible state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters
theorems.summary: For admissible states the averaged sound speed is positive and its square is (γ−1)(H̄ − Q(ū)/2).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic
theorems.summary: The shifted Roe matrix satisfies the cubic identity (Ã − q̄)³ = c̄²(Ã − q̄) for a unit normal.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors
theorems.summary: The acoustic, contact and shear vectors are eigenvectors of the Roe matrix with speeds q̄ ∓ c̄ and q̄.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_algebra
theorems.summary: The three Roe spectral projectors are idempotent and have zero mutual products.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum
theorems.summary: The three Roe spectral projectors sum to the identity.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranges
theorems.summary: Each Roe projector's range is the eigenspace of its wave speed.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions
theorems.summary: The Roe eigenspaces have dimensions 1, 3 and 1.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_ranks
theorems.summary: The Roe projectors have ranks 1, 3 and 1.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis
theorems.summary: The Roe matrix has a complete basis of five eigenvectors.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomposition
theorems.summary: The Roe matrix is the speed-weighted sum of its three spectral projectors.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tangent_span
theorems.summary: The contact vector and the shear vectors of any tangent basis span the convective eigenspace.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension
theorems.summary: The plane tangent to a unit normal has dimension 2.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.exists_tangent_basis
theorems.summary: The plane tangent to a unit normal has a basis.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis
theorems.summary: The Roe dissipation operator equals R diag(|speeds|) R⁻¹ for every complete eigenbasis R.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen
theorems.summary: Every eigenvector of the Roe matrix with eigenvalue μ is an eigenvector of the dissipation operator with eigenvalue |μ|.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_matrix_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the normal negates the Roe matrix.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the normal negates the shifted Roe matrix.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the normal exchanges the two acoustic projectors.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the normal negates the Roe wave speeds and reverses their order.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_reverse
theorems.summary: The Roe dissipation operator is invariant under normal reversal.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap
theorems.summary: The shifted Roe matrix, projectors and dissipation are symmetric in the two states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_consistency
theorems.summary: The Roe numerical flux of two equal states is the physical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_reverse
theorems.summary: Swapping the states and reversing the area vector negates the Roe numerical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_zero
theorems.summary: The Roe numerical flux through a zero area vector is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_scale
theorems.summary: The Roe numerical flux scales linearly with nonnegative multiples of the area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_left
theorems.summary: If the Roe normal speed is at least the averaged sound speed, the Roe flux is the left physical flux (sonic case included).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_right
theorems.summary: If the Roe normal speed is at most minus the averaged sound speed, the Roe flux is the right physical flux (sonic case included).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.witness_intermediate_coordinates
theorems.summary: The Roe intermediate state of the receding-state witness has the stated exact coordinates.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Roe.positivity_counterexample
theorems.summary: Two admissible states with positive averaged sound-speed square have a Roe intermediate state with negative density.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail
theorems.summary: Edge incidence is +1 at the tail node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head
theorems.summary: Edge incidence is −1 at the head node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other
theorems.summary: Edge incidence is 0 at a node that is neither tail nor head.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_one
theorems.summary: Edge incidence is +1 exactly at the tail node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_eq_neg_one
theorems.summary: Edge incidence is −1 exactly at the head node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum
theorems.summary: The incidences of an edge sum to zero over all nodes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul
theorems.summary: Incidence times a vector is the vector at the tail minus the vector at the head.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing
theorems.summary: The assembled residual is outgoing tail transfers minus incoming head transfers plus owned boundary transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.global_balance
theorems.summary: For arbitrary edge and boundary transfers the nodal residuals sum to the total boundary transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance
theorems.summary: With Roe edge transfers the nodal residuals sum to the total boundary transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq
theorems.summary: The outward Roe transfer of an edge at a node is the incidence times the edge Roe transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing a set of edges and negating their transfers leaves every assembled residual unchanged.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing a set of edges, with swapped endpoints and reversed area vectors, leaves every Roe residual unchanged.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex
theorems.summary: The assembled residual commutes with relabeling of nodes, edges and boundary pieces.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex
theorems.summary: The Roe residual commutes with relabeling of nodes, edges and boundary pieces with transported data.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero
theorems.summary: An edge with zero area vector has zero Roe transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_sum
theorems.summary: The four face area vectors of a tetrahedron sum to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum
theorems.summary: The boundary area vectors of each median-dual flag tetrahedron sum to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot
theorems.summary: The outward dual triangle of a flag dotted with its edge vector is one 24th of six times the tetrahedron volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_reverse
theorems.summary: Local median-dual interface vectors are antisymmetric in their two nodes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq
theorems.summary: A local boundary patch is one third of the face vector, or zero at the vertex opposite the face.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_one
theorems.summary: The first family of internal flag faces cancels when summed over the flags of a vertex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sum_internal_two
theorems.summary: The second family of internal flag faces cancels when summed over the flags of a vertex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_identify
theorems.summary: The flag boundary vectors of a vertex sum to its local hull vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identification
theorems.summary: The local hull vector of a vertex is the sum of its interface vectors and boundary patches.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure
theorems.summary: In one tetrahedron the interface vectors and boundary patches of each vertex sum to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.mem_faceNodes
theorems.summary: A node lies on face j of a cell iff it is a cell vertex other than vertex j.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.face_membership
theorems.summary: A three-node set lies in a cell iff it is one of the cell's faces.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.faceArea_cancel
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh two distinct occurrences of the same primal face have opposite area vectors.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_reverse
theorems.summary: Assembled median-dual edge area vectors are antisymmetric.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.assembledArea_row
theorems.summary: The assembled areas at a node sum to its local interface vectors summed over all cells.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_incidence_sum
theorems.summary: The incidence-signed edge areas at a node equal the row sum of assembled areas.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.ownedPatch_local
theorems.summary: The patch area a node owns on a face occurrence is the corresponding local patch.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.interior_cancel
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh the patches on interior faces cancel at every node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_injective
theorems.summary: A boundary record is determined by its face and owner key.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.boundaryKey_range
theorems.summary: Boundary keys are exactly the pairs of a face used once and a node on that face.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.all_patches_boundary
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh all patches at a node sum to the areas of its boundary records.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.metric_closed
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh the median dual of every node is metrically closed (zero metric defect).

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.roe_boundary_balance
theorems.summary: On a concrete median-dual mesh the Roe residuals sum to the total boundary transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_card
theorems.summary: A tetrahedron has 24 median-dual flags.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.vertexFlags_card
theorems.summary: Each tetrahedron vertex has 6 median-dual flags.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant
theorems.summary: Each flag's signed six-volume is its frame sign times one 24th of the tetrahedron's.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume
theorems.summary: Each flag's volume is one 24th of the tetrahedron's volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq
theorems.summary: The local dual volume of a vertex in a tetrahedron is a quarter of its volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_formula
theorems.summary: A node's dual volume is the sum of Vol(T)/4 over its incident cells.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_pos
theorems.summary: Used nodes have positive dual volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.dualVolume_unused
theorems.summary: Unused nodes have zero dual volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_partition
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh the dual volumes sum to the total cell volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual
theorems.summary: For a common state with physical boundary transfers the residual is the physical flux through the metric defect.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed
theorems.summary: A common state with physical boundary transfers has zero residual at every node with zero metric defect.

theorems.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.constant_state
theorems.summary: On a conforming median-dual mesh a common state with physical boundary transfers has zero residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_unique
theorems.summary: A boundary record is determined by its primal face and owner node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.boundary_record_range
theorems.summary: Boundary records exist exactly for the faces used once and the nodes on them.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind_coherent
theorems.summary: The boundary kind is the same on all records of one primal face.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior_coherent
theorems.summary: The prescribed exterior state is the same on all records of one primal face.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_wall
theorems.summary: On a slip-wall record the patch transfer is the wall transfer at the owner state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_symmetry
theorems.summary: On an inviscid symmetry record the patch transfer is the wall transfer at the owner state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer_prescribed
theorems.summary: On a prescribed-exterior record the patch transfer is the Roe transfer between owner and exterior states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass
theorems.summary: The wall transfer has zero mass component.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy
theorems.summary: The wall transfer has zero energy component.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum
theorems.summary: The wall transfer's momentum is the owner pressure times the area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_zero
theorems.summary: The wall transfer through a zero area vector is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add
theorems.summary: The wall transfer is additive in the area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul
theorems.summary: The wall transfer is homogeneous in the area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse
theorems.summary: Reversing the area vector negates the wall transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos
theorems.summary: An admissible state has positive pressure.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff
theorems.summary: The wall transfer equals the physical flux iff the normal momentum is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_normalVelocity
theorems.summary: For positive density and nonzero area the wall transfer equals the physical flux iff the normal velocity is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_consistency
theorems.summary: The prescribed-exterior Roe transfer with exterior state equal to the owner state is the physical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_zero
theorems.summary: The prescribed-exterior transfer through a zero area vector is zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_scale
theorems.summary: The prescribed-exterior transfer scales with nonnegative multiples of the area vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_reverse
theorems.summary: Swapping owner and exterior states and reversing the area negates the prescribed-exterior transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_owner
theorems.summary: If the Roe normal speed is at least the sound speed the prescribed-exterior transfer is the owner's physical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.prescribed_upwind_exterior
theorems.summary: If the Roe normal speed is at most minus the sound speed the prescribed-exterior transfer is the exterior physical flux.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balance
theorems.summary: With the selected boundary transfers the nodal residuals sum to the total boundary transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balance
theorems.summary: The total residual splits into prescribed-exterior Roe transfers and wall/symmetry transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance
theorems.summary: The total mass residual is the mass transfer through prescribed-exterior faces only.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_energy_balance
theorems.summary: The total energy residual is the energy transfer through prescribed-exterior faces only.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_balance
theorems.summary: The total momentum residual is the prescribed-exterior momentum transfer plus the wall/symmetry pressure forces.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq
theorems.summary: The concrete mesh residual is the M3 Roe residual with the selected patch transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance
theorems.summary: On a concrete mesh the nodal residuals sum to the total patch transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.constructed_transfer_reindex
theorems.summary: The constructed boundary transfers commute with relabeling, including boundary kinds and exterior data.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_reindex
theorems.summary: The stationary residual commutes with relabeling of nodes, edges and boundary records.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex
theorems.summary: The concrete mesh residual commutes with relabeling of nodes, edges and boundary records.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible
theorems.summary: With wall tangency or a matching exterior state the boundary transfer is the physical transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_defect
theorems.summary: For a common state with compatible boundaries the residual is the physical flux through the metric defect.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_closed
theorems.summary: For a common state with compatible boundaries the residual vanishes at every node with zero metric defect.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_correction
theorems.summary: For a common state the residual is the defect flux plus the owned differences between constructed and physical transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh a common admissible state with tangent walls and matching exterior data has zero residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh a common state's residual is the owned sum of patch transfer minus physical transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.euler_coordinates
theorems.summary: The explicit Euler step subtracts (τ/v) times the residual in state coordinates.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.euler_zero_step
theorems.summary: A zero time step leaves the state unchanged.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.euler_zero_residual
theorems.summary: A zero residual leaves the state unchanged.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.euler_amount
theorems.summary: For nonzero volume the step changes the amount v·U by −τ times the residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount
theorems.summary: At a used node the mesh step changes the dual-volume amount by −τ times the old-state residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_zero_step
theorems.summary: Zero time steps leave every nodal state unchanged.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_used_volume_pos
theorems.summary: Used nodes have positive dual volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.tail_used
theorems.summary: The tail of every edge is a used node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.head_used
theorems.summary: The head of every edge is a used node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.owner_used
theorems.summary: The owner of every boundary record is a used node.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_residual_unused
theorems.summary: The mesh residual vanishes at unused nodes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used
theorems.summary: At a used node the mesh step is the explicit Euler update with its dual volume.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_unused
theorems.summary: At an unused node the mesh step holds the state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_used
theorems.summary: The total amount equals the amount summed over used nodes only.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.unused_all
theorems.summary: In the unused-node control the unused node has zero volume, zero residual and a held state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_amount_change
theorems.summary: The step changes the total amount by minus the step-weighted sum of nodal residuals.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance
theorems.summary: With a common step on used nodes the total amount changes by −dt times the total patch transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physical
theorems.summary: For admissible nodal and exterior states and a common nonnegative step the total amount changes by −dt times the total patch transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance
theorems.summary: With a common step each amount component changes by −dt times its total boundary transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_mass_balance
theorems.summary: With a common step the total mass changes only by the prescribed-exterior mass transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance
theorems.summary: With a common step the total energy changes only by the prescribed-exterior energy transfer.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance
theorems.summary: With a common step the total momentum changes by the prescribed-exterior transfer and the wall/symmetry pressure forces.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_mass
theorems.summary: With only wall/symmetry boundaries a common step conserves total mass.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_traction_energy
theorems.summary: With only wall/symmetry boundaries a common step conserves total energy.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual
theorems.summary: Node-weighted residuals sum to step differences across edges times edge transfers plus owner-weighted boundary transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance
theorems.summary: With local steps the total amount changes by the edge step-difference defect plus owner-weighted boundary transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical
theorems.summary: For admissible data and nonnegative local steps the same edge-defect balance holds with the actual Roe transfers.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.local_amount_change
theorems.summary: In the standard control unequal local steps change the total amount by an exact nonzero vector.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.local_nonconservation
theorems.summary: In the standard control unequal local steps do not conserve the total amount.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.local_updated_admissible
theorems.summary: In the standard local-step control every updated state is admissible.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_state
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh a compatible common admissible state is preserved by any nonnegative steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.standard_mixed_common
theorems.summary: On the standard tetrahedron with mixed boundary kinds a compatible moving state is preserved.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.standard_wall_rest
theorems.summary: On the all-wall standard tetrahedron a state at rest is preserved.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.oblique_rest
theorems.summary: On the oblique all-symmetry tetrahedron a state at rest is preserved.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.two_cell_common
theorems.summary: On the two-cell mesh with mixed boundaries a compatible moving state is preserved.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.hot_cold_residual
theorems.summary: An incompatible hot/cold boundary control has the stated exact nonzero residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.negative_density_update
theorems.summary: A large step in the hot/cold control produces the stated update with negative density.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.negative_update_not_admissible
theorems.summary: The large-step hot/cold update is not admissible.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.held_reindex
theorems.summary: The held explicit step commutes with relabeling of nodes and transported data.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.amount_reindex
theorems.summary: The total amount is invariant under relabeling of nodes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex
theorems.summary: The mesh step commutes with relabeling of nodes, edges and boundary records with fully transported residual data.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.transported_nonconstant
theorems.summary: The relabeled two-cell step with nonconstant transported data equals the original step.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.Controls.transported_fields_nonconstant
theorems.summary: In the relabeling control the volumes, steps, states and exterior data differ between the swapped nodes and faces.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.logMean_properties
theorems.summary: The logarithmic mean of two positive numbers is symmetric, positive, equals a at a = b, and satisfies b − a = L(a,b)(log b − log a).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus
theorems.summary: On a nondegenerate simplex the P1 gradients sum to zero, are dual to the edges, reproduce the identity, and the facet vectors sum to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3
theorems.summary: A tetrahedron facet vector is half the cross product of two facet edges oriented away from the opposite vertex; neighbours across a triangle have opposite facet vectors.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2
theorems.summary: A triangle facet vector is the rotated facet edge pointing away from the opposite vertex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex_nonobtuse
theorems.summary: Every Kuhn tetrahedron of a brick is nondegenerate with pairwise nonpositive gradient products (no obtuse dihedral angle).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nW_row_sum
theorems.summary: For any dual of the P1 operator the edge normals at a node sum to −β_i, and β_i = 0 at a closed vertex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.sbp_defect
theorems.summary: For any dual the P1 operator satisfies c + cᵀ = B + 2E with E symmetric with zero row sums, and c has zero row sums and column sums β.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff
theorems.summary: On a nondegenerate simplex all off-diagonal SBP defect terms vanish iff the dual weights are the median weights.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge
theorems.summary: Dual normals satisfy n·e = 2μ > 0 on edges, and the edge projection ν is a positive multiple of e with |ν| = n·e/|e|.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_outer
theorems.summary: The Galerkin coefficients give Σ c⊗e = V·I, dual normals give Σ n⊗e = 2V·I at closed vertices, and the dual volumes sum to |Ω|.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration
theorems.summary: At closed vertices the edge-projected tensor G(ν) has trace 2dV and G(n) has trace at least 2dV, with equality iff every normal is a nonnegative multiple of its edge.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratic_edge_expansion
theorems.summary: For a quadratic field the weighted edge-difference sum is its first-order part plus V times the dissipation tensor contracted with the Hessian.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner
theorems.summary: The edge dissipation tensor with full normals dominates the edge-projected one in the Loewner order, with equality iff the normals are parallel to the edges.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace
theorems.summary: Under uniform edge scaling the dissipation tensor is s·G/(4V), its projected trace is ds/2, and the trace is bounded by (d/2)σ_max h.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_of_facetPaired
theorems.summary: A facet pairing at a vertex makes it a closed vertex of the P1 operator (zero boundary-matrix row).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary
theorems.summary: On a conforming mesh β and the boundary matrix B are sums over boundary facets, and a vertex on no boundary facet is closed.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_boundary
theorems.summary: Conforming meshes are facet balanced, and on facet-balanced meshes β and B are boundary-facet sums with interior vertices closed.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_of_sideBalanced
theorems.summary: On a mesh of nondegenerate tetrahedra side balance implies facet balance.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.facetBalanced_of_sideBalanced2
theorems.summary: On a mesh of nondegenerate triangles side balance implies facet balance.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.antisymmetric_pairFlux
theorems.summary: Antisymmetric pair fluxes are globally conservative, and their entropy production is half the sum of entropy-variable jumps times the fluxes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.entropyConservative_production
theorems.summary: An entropy-conservative central pair flux produces only the boundary term Σ ψ_i·β_i.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_conservation
theorems.summary: Central flux plus scalar second/fourth-difference dissipation with symmetric coefficients is antisymmetric and globally conservative.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_freeStream
theorems.summary: A uniform state with matching boundary data has zero residual for the dissipative pair-flux scheme.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.edgeForm_boundary_split
theorems.summary: For row sums 0 and column sums β the edge form plus ½(B F + diag β F) equals the Galerkin form c F.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entropy
theorems.summary: The standard boundary closure on a conforming mesh produces the lumped facet entropy flux plus a per-facet jump defect.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear
theorems.summary: For linear fluxes the standard boundary closure equals ½(B + diag β)F with weights (d+3):1.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_entropy
theorems.summary: The quadrature boundary closure has an exact boundary entropy identity and conserves Σ_i b_i = Σ_q F*_q.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_freeStream
theorems.summary: With a uniform state, physical boundary fluxes and matching quadrature normals the quadrature closure has zero residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.quadratureClosure_linear
theorems.summary: For linear fluxes the quadrature closure is ½(F_i β_i + Σ_k F_k Σ_q φ_qi φ_qk N_q).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B
theorems.summary: A boundary face quadrature rule with the stated moments reproduces β and the boundary matrix B on a conforming mesh.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.galerkin_identity
theorems.summary: The w-weighted sum of Galerkin residuals is minus the cell-weighted Frobenius product of the P1 gradient of w and the element fluxes.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.fvRes_eq_galerkinRes
theorems.summary: With dual facet vectors m_T(g_k − g_i) the finite-volume residual of element fluxes equals the Galerkin residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin
theorems.summary: At a closed vertex the mean edge flux through the dual normals equals the Galerkin form Σ_k c_ik F_k.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.pair_production_integral
theorems.summary: The pair entropy production is exactly the path integral of the derivative along the straight segment in entropy variables, with no remainder.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.ofMeshData_closed
theorems.summary: In a conforming tetrahedral median-dual mesh a vertex on no boundary face is closed for the induced P1 operator.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.dualFacets_grad
theorems.summary: The median-dual facets of a tetrahedron (and of a triangle) are (|T|/(d+1))(g_k − g_i) in terms of P1 gradients.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Num.ofMeshData_fv_galerkin
theorems.summary: On a median-dual tetrahedral mesh the finite-volume residual over the dual facets equals the Galerkin residual.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.fluxDifference_sum_zero
theorems.summary: On a finite periodic grid the interface flux differences of any two-point flux sum to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs_sum_zero
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 the periodic first-order finite-volume right-hand side of any two-point flux sums to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.consistent
theorems.summary: The Burgers Rusanov (local Lax-Friedrichs) flux with wave speed max(|uL|, |uR|) equals the physical flux u²/2 on equal states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs_constant
theorems.summary: A consistent two-point flux gives a zero periodic finite-volume right-hand side on a constant state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.semidiscrete_constant
theorems.summary: The Burgers Rusanov semidiscretization on ZMod N is zero on a constant state (composition of B0-F and B0-K).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.semidiscrete_sum_zero
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 the Burgers Rusanov semidiscretization on ZMod N sums to zero (instance of B0-C).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step_zero_rhs
theorems.summary: A Forward Euler step with a zero right-hand side at the state returns the state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step_constant
theorems.summary: A Forward Euler step keeps a constant state when the right-hand side is zero on it.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step_sum
theorems.summary: A Forward Euler step keeps the total sum when the right-hand side sums to zero.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_preserves_constant
theorems.summary: The Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step on ZMod N keeps every constant state, for every dx and dt.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_preserves_sum
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 the Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step on ZMod N keeps the total sum of the cell averages.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_preserves_integral
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 the Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step on ZMod N keeps the discrete integral dx · Σ u.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate_totalVariation_le
theorems.summary: Harten lemma: an incremental-form update with C, D ≥ 0 and C + D ≤ 1 at every interface does not increase the periodic total variation.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate_bounds
theorems.summary: An incremental-form update with C_i, D_{i-1} ≥ 0 and C_i + D_{i-1} ≤ 1 keeps every lower and upper bound of the old state at cell i.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.monotone
theorems.summary: The Burgers Rusanov flux is nondecreasing in the left state and nonincreasing in the right state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_waveSpeed
theorems.summary: The mean of two states is bounded in absolute value by the Rusanov wave speed max(|a|, |b|).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.step_eq_incrementalUpdate
theorems.summary: The Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step is in incremental form with C = (dt/dx)(a − ū)/2 and D = (dt/dx)(a + ū)/2.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.step_totalVariation_le
theorems.summary: For dx > 0, dt ≥ 0 and dt · a_i ≤ dx at every interface the Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step does not increase the total variation, on any periodic grid.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.step_bounds
theorems.summary: For dx > 0, dt ≥ 0 and 2 · dt · a_i ≤ dx at every interface the Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler step keeps every lower and upper bound of the old state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_totalVariation_le
theorems.summary: Total variation under the per-interface CFL hypothesis for the assembled scheme on ZMod N.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_bounds
theorems.summary: Bounds under the per-interface CFL 1/2 hypothesis for the assembled scheme on ZMod N.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates_convex
theorems.summary: The set of cell functions with m ≤ u_j ≤ M in every cell is convex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation_convexOn
theorems.summary: The periodic total variation is a convex functional on every convex set of states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed_le_of_bounds
theorems.summary: For states between m and M the Rusanov wave speed is at most max(|m|, |M|).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2_forwardEuler
theorems.summary: SSPRK2 over a Forward Euler map is Heun's method: u + (dt/2)(L(u) + L(u + dt L(u))).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2_mem
theorems.summary: SSPRK2 keeps every convex set that the one-step map keeps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk3_mem
theorems.summary: SSPRK3 keeps every convex set that the one-step map keeps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2_le
theorems.summary: SSPRK2 does not increase a functional that is convex on an invariant set and not increased by the one-step map.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk3_le
theorems.summary: SSPRK3 does not increase a functional that is convex on an invariant set and not increased by the one-step map.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.iterate_mem
theorems.summary: A one-step map that keeps a set keeps it for every number of steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.iterate_le
theorems.summary: A functional not increased by one step on an invariant set is not increased by n steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2_fixed
theorems.summary: A fixed point of the one-step map is a fixed point of SSPRK2.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk3_fixed
theorems.summary: A fixed point of the one-step map is a fixed point of SSPRK3.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2_linear
theorems.summary: A linear functional kept by the one-step map is kept by SSPRK2.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk3_linear
theorems.summary: A linear functional kept by the one-step map is kept by SSPRK3.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem
theorems.summary: For dx > 0, dt ≥ 0 and 2 · dt · max(|m|, |M|) ≤ dx the Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler map keeps the bounds m ≤ u ≤ M.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalVariation_le
theorems.summary: Under the same hypothesis the Forward Euler map does not increase the total variation of a state with m ≤ u ≤ M.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterate_stable
theorems.summary: After n Burgers Rusanov Forward Euler steps with one dt from the initial bounds, the bounds hold and the total variation is not larger.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk2Step_iterate_stable
theorems.summary: The same multi-step bounds and total-variation result for n SSPRK2 steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk3Step_iterate_stable
theorems.summary: The same multi-step bounds and total-variation result for n SSPRK3 steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk2Step_sum
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 one Burgers Rusanov SSPRK2 step keeps the total sum of the cell values.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk3Step_sum
theorems.summary: For dx ≠ 0 one Burgers Rusanov SSPRK3 step keeps the total sum of the cell values.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk2Step_constant
theorems.summary: One Burgers Rusanov SSPRK2 step keeps every constant state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.ssprk3Step_constant
theorems.summary: One Burgers Rusanov SSPRK3 step keeps every constant state.

theorems.summary: The minmod limiter has the sign of both differences and is not larger than either in absolute value.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.zero_minmodBounded
theorems.summary: The zero limiter (first-order reconstruction) satisfies the limiter certificate.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.musclRhs_sum_zero
theorems.summary: The periodic MUSCL right-hand side sums to zero for every two-point flux and every limiter.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.musclRhs_constant
theorems.summary: The MUSCL right-hand side is zero on a constant state, for every flux and every limiter.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.leftState_mem
theorems.summary: With a limiter in the minmod region the reconstructed left state of an interface keeps the bounds m ≤ u ≤ M.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rightState_mem
theorems.summary: With a limiter in the minmod region the reconstructed right state of an interface keeps the bounds m ≤ u ≤ M.

theorems.summary: For a monotone flux that is Lipschitz on bounded states and a limiter in the minmod region, the MUSCL Forward Euler step is an incremental update with 0 ≤ C ≤ (dt/dx)(3/2)KR and 0 ≤ D ≤ (dt/dx)(3/2)KL.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_left

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval_lipschitz_right
theorems.summary: For states with absolute value at most A the Burgers Rusanov flux is Lipschitz in the right state with constant 2A.

theorems.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.lipschitzOnBounds
theorems.summary: Lipschitz certificate of the Burgers Rusanov flux on states between m and M with constants 2 max(|m|, |M|).

theorems.name: CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.muscl_step_totalVariation_le

theorems.summary: Bounds and total variation after n MUSCL-Rusanov SSPRK2 steps.

theorems.summary: Bounds and total variation after n MUSCL-Rusanov SSPRK3 steps.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_1
theorems.summary: Wall-normal model of the fourth difference at a weak wall: L_k = (r−1)h f'(y_k) + ½(1+r²)h² f''(y_k) + O(h³) for a C³ profile, first order if r ≠ 1.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_2
theorems.summary: One-node balance of the fourth-difference wall term with the wall penalty: the unique wall slip −ϱL⁰/(1+ϱ) is opposite to the flow.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_3
theorems.summary: The momentum rows of the second-difference flux of the scheme are λε2(ρv_s − ρv_k), a difference without a power of h.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_4
theorems.summary: Cutting ε2 = ε4 = 0 on the wall-crossing edges removes only those dissipation terms, keeps the hypotheses of the complete scheme, and splits Π² and Π⁴ exactly.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_5
theorems.summary: Linear wall-normal profile on a geometric mesh: L_k − L_s = (r−1)(ũ_k − ũ_s), and the fourth-difference wall flux produces ε4(r−1)λ[w]·[ũ] ≥ 0.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_15_6
theorems.summary: Linear model of the fourth-difference operator with the wall-crossing edges cut: every complex eigenvalue is real and non-negative.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_16_1
theorems.summary: The P1 interpolant of nodal fluxes takes the nodal values, has derivative Σ_b g_b F_b, reproduces affine fluxes, and its divergence gives the mean flux at a closed vertex.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_16_2
theorems.summary: A symmetric, consistent two-point flux that is C² near the diagonal differs from the mean flux by O(|u_k − u_i|²).

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_16_3
theorems.summary: ε2 ≤ 6κ2, ε4 ≤ 9κ4, and the weak effect of the scalar dissipation is at most d(6κ2 + 18n_Eκ4) Φmax σmax h |Ω| Gφ Gu.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_16_4
theorems.summary: On the face vector the dissipation sum is at least Σ c̄ (n·e) sec ϑ, which is unbounded at fixed |Ω| on stretched triangles.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_17_1
theorems.summary: Continuous SST entropy balance: ∂_t η0 + ∇·(v η0 + G) = Π for smooth solutions, with G = −v^η·F^v = θκ∇T (− θD_k∇k).

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_18_1
theorems.summary: The Euler entropy −ρs/(γ−1) has a positive definite Hessian at admissible states.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p4_18_2
theorems.summary: The SST coupled entropy η0 has a positive semidefinite Hessian with null space span{e_E + e_k, e_ω}.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_19_1
theorems.summary: The logarithmic mean is Cⁿ for every n on (0,∞)², across the diagonal a = b (L(a,b) = a·E(ln b − ln a) with E(t) = (eᵗ−1)/t analytic).

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_19_2
theorems.summary: The admissible Euler states form an open set, and the Ismail-Roe flux is Cⁿ for every n on admissible × admissible, diagonal included.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_19_3
theorems.summary: At every admissible state the Ismail-Roe flux differs from the mean of the Euler fluxes by at most C|y||u_k − u_i|² near the diagonal, one constant for all vectors y.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_20_1
theorems.summary: The paper's Euler state and M1's conservative state correspond one to one (toState, ofState inverse; density, momentum, energy agree).

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_20_2
theorems.summary: The paper's pressure, admissibility, velocity and primitive-to-conservative map equal M1's.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_20_3
theorems.summary: The paper's Euler flux on a vector y equals M1's integrated physical flux on the area vector y, for every state.

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p5_20_4

theorems.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.p6_21_1
theorems.summary: The closed simplex (convex hull of the vertices) is where all barycentric coordinates are ≥ 0, and its Lebesgue measure is |det(x_β − x_0)|/d!.
